richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pimpri Chinchwad

c: Pimpri Chinchwad grew around its automobile and engineering plants in Bhosari, Pimpri and Chinchwad, and newer housing in Wakad, Ravet and Moshi has filled in around them. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pimpri Chinchwad for large housing societies, factory campuses, schools and the gardens of the Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation. Our Vasai factory is about 130 km away, a short road trip across the ghats.

Our own team or a dealer installs the machines once they reach the site. The climate is easy for outdoor exercise for much of the year, with warm summers, a steady monsoon from June to September and cool, dry winters. Big societies here can have hundreds of flats and a long podium or garden. That scale suits one central frame for groups, with smaller machines spread along the walking track.

items.q: Can a factory in Bhosari MIDC set up an outdoor gym for workers?
items.a: Yes. Share the open area, a few photos and how many workers use the canteen per shift. We will suggest machines and send a layout drawing with a quote.

items.q: Can the gym go on a podium slab?
items.a: Often, yes. The fixing method depends on the slab, so your structural engineer should approve it. We show each machine's footprint and clear space on the layout drawing.

items.q: When should we plan the installation?
items.a: Before June or after the monsoon ends. Grouted footings need a few dry days to set, so we agree the installation date with you after you approve the layout.
